text: Looking at my emotional experience through the different doors is really a new perspective. This seminar reminds me to truly ask God to search my heart, not just to affirm it. The example of BREATHE, PAUSE, THEN TELL is one I should be practising when there is a trigger (Help me, God!). I also love seeing the Bible characters like David and Peter through another lens, and the conversation between Jesus and Peter at the seashore. So thankful for this seminar.
